implication_for_p2: The 40-task subset (median 153 tool calls) will have DIFFERENT compaction trigger rates per arm: agentic triggers earlier (~120k) so more tasks will compact; basic triggers later (~230k) so fewer tasks will compact. This is itself a finding (agentic is more proactive). P1 pilot (8 tasks) should measure: (1) what fraction of tasks trigger compaction per arm, (2) compression rate per trigger (≥70% gate), (3) Pass@1 per arm. If agentic triggers on most tasks but basic triggers on few, the ablation effectively compares 'compaction happened' vs 'compaction did not happen' — still scientifically valid but different from the plan's intent of 'same trigger point, different strategy'.
